name: Atypical
description: Sam, an 18-year-old on the autism spectrum, takes a funny, yet painful, journey of self-discovery for love and independence and upends his family.

videos.title: Antarctica
videos.overview: Interested in having a girlfriend, Sam researches dating advice and puts it to the test. Meanwhile, his overprotective mom Elsa must learn to let go.

videos.title: A Human Female
videos.overview: When Sam learns his crush is already taken, dad Doug helps him woo her. A lost credit card sends Elsa back to the bar. Casey hears rumors about Evan.

videos.title: Julia Says
videos.overview: Sam decides to update his look. Casey learns a family secret. Feeling like her family no longer needs her, Elsa seeks attention elsewhere.

videos.title: A Nice Neutral Smell
videos.overview: When a classmate shows interest in him, Sam makes a list of pros and cons to see whether she's girlfriend material. Casey gets a prestigious offer.

videos.title: That’s My Sweatshirt
videos.overview: Sam becomes rattled after Paige invades his bedroom. Casey visits Clayton Prep and gets a taste of what life away from her brother would be like.

videos.title: The D-Train to Bone Town
videos.overview: Paige proposes having an autism-friendly school dance to the PTA. Sam makes preparations for losing his virginity. Doug and Julia help each other.

videos.title: I Lost My Poor Meatball
videos.overview: When Paige makes a confession to Sam, he creates a checklist to figure how he feels. Things with Nick suddenly get too real for Elsa.

videos.title: The Silencing Properties of Snow
videos.overview: After a disastrous dinner with Paige's family, Sam makes amends at the school dance. Casey's fury at her mom affects her relationship with Evan.

videos.title: Juiced!
videos.overview: Sam's frustration at being unable to find a therapist and Casey's anxiety about going to a new school spark a blowup between the two.

videos.title: Penguin Cam and Chill
videos.overview: Casey feels less than welcome at Clayton. Sam asks Paige to spell out the rules of their "casual relationship," while Doug sets boundaries with Elsa.

videos.title: Little Dude and the Lion
videos.overview: A peer group meeting leads Sam to an important decision. Detention with Izzie shows Casey they have more in common than she thought.

videos.title: Pants on Fire
videos.overview: Zahid teaches Sam to lie, while Elsa practices being honest. Evan helps Casey get over an embarrassment. A doctor visit forces Julia out of denial.

videos.title: The Egg Is Pipping
videos.overview: In peer group, Sam realizes he needs to manage his own money. Doug gets advice from Megan on dealing with Elsa. Evan meets Casey's new friends.

videos.title: In the Dragon's Lair
videos.overview: To prepare for college life, Sam sleeps over at Zahid's. Sam's $700 loss reunites Doug and Elsa with Arlo's parents, former friends of theirs.

videos.title: The Smudging
videos.overview: Casey tells Izzie what Nate did. Sam tries to figure out which colleges to apply to. Doug discovers a need to educate first responders about autism.

videos.title: Living at an Angle
videos.overview: Sam loses his portfolio for his art school application and panics. Megan gets flirty with Doug, who makes a decision about Elsa. Julia calls Miles.

videos.title: Ritual-licious
videos.overview: Ignoring Casey's wishes, Elsa throws her a big birthday party, while Sam insists on following a decade-old birthday ritual. The bartender haunts Doug.

videos.title: Ernest Shackleton's Rules for Survival
videos.overview: Cruel yearbook comments show Sam who's got his back, a favor he repays at graduation. Feelings for Izzie confuse Casey. Elsa asks Doug a key question.

videos.title: Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Paige invites Sam to redefine their romance, Casey struggles with complicated feelings, and Elsa attempts to find a new normal with Doug.

videos.title: Standing Sam
videos.overview: Sam makes a bold move amid the buzz of orientation day. Casey crosses paths with Nate. Elsa and Doug unpack the hazards of half-truths.

videos.title: Cocaine Pills and Pony Meat
videos.overview: An ethics professor pushes Sam to his limits. Elsa keeps an eye on Doug ... and Megan. Casey considers her future and encourages Evan to do the same.

videos.title: Y.G.A.G.G.
videos.overview: Casey and Evan take to the open road for a tense reunion. Back home, Sam and Zahid get ready to party, and Elsa bids farewell to the past.

videos.title: Only Tweed
videos.overview: As Paige makes a plan in the face of adversity, Sam awaits a crucial academic update. Elsa endures an uncomfortable encounter.

videos.title: The Essence of a Penguin
videos.overview: Sam’s art assignment inspires an impromptu field trip. Casey navigates a fight with Izzie. Evan works hard for a second chance with Doug.

videos.title: Shrinkage
videos.overview: While Sam and Casey face friendship dilemmas, Elsa uncovers a charming surprise, and Doug makes an unexpected decision.

videos.title: Road Rage Paige
videos.overview: A hard truth keeps Casey up at night. Sam experiences a rough season with Zahid -- and Paige. Elsa and Doug brace for their next chapter.

videos.title: Sam Takes a Walk
videos.overview: As Sam gets political with his art, Elsa and Doug explore a (not-so-normal) weekend away. Casey and Izzie re-examine their relationship.

videos.title: Searching for Brown Sugar Man
videos.overview: A rogue plan for Zahid leads to a last-minute mission for Sam, Casey, Paige and Abby. Meanwhile, Doug faces a major test and makes a pivotal choice.

videos.title: Magical Bird #1
videos.overview: Sam's living situation with Zahid gets off to a rocky start, while Elsa struggles with her son's departure. Casey weighs telling Doug about Izzie.

videos.title: Master of Penguins
videos.overview: Casey's demanding schedule starts affecting her grades, while Sam seeks out some extra credit himself. A chance run-in revives old suspicions for Elsa.

videos.title: You Say You Want a Revolution
videos.overview: A change at work leaves Sam scrambling for cash. When Izzie fights the school dress code, Casey feels conflicted. Paige discovers a knack for management.

videos.title: Starters and Endings
videos.overview: Casey and Izzie face fallout from the protest. Paige tries to prove her mettle to Casey through strange tasks. Doug avoids dealing with a painful loss.

videos.title: Dead Dreams
videos.overview: As Sam gets ready for an adventure, Elsa thinks about ways to discourage him. Casey gets an up-close look at Izzie's tense home life.

videos.title: Are You in Fair Health?
videos.overview: Sam seeks a worthy caretaker for Edison. Casey tries to be supportive of Izzie, but her plan backfires. Zahid shares tough news with Sam.

videos.title: Channel the Cat
videos.overview: Elsa makes a meaningful reconnection. Paige plans a romantic night with Sam. Pressure mounts on Casey ahead of a big track meet.

videos.title: Magical Bird #2
videos.overview: As Casey reaches a crossroads, she finds herself questioning a lot of things. But in the meantime, she helps Sam get over a hurdle of his own.

videos.title: Player's Ball
videos.overview: Casey and Sam fume about their parents meddling in their lives. Zahid hosts a big send-off for something near and dear.

videos.title: Dessert at Olive Garden
videos.overview: Sam deals with a big disappointment, Casey clashes with Elsa over college plans, and a recurring dream vexes Doug.
